## Thundershrike (CR 9)

**XP** 25,600  
 N Huge magical beast  

**Init** +2; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +17  

  

**Defense**

 **AC** 20, touch 11, flat-footed 17 (+1 dodge, +2 Dex, +9 natural, -2 size)  

**hp** 195 (13d10+65)  

**Fort** +13, **Ref** +10, **Will** +7  

  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 20 ft., fly 70 ft. (average)  

**Melee** 2 claws +19 (1d8+8), bite +20 (2d6+8)  

**Space** 15 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  

**Spell-like Abilities** (CL 13th):  
  At will—gust of wind (DC 15)  

2/day—lightning bolt (DC 16 half)  

1/day—control weather  

  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 26, **Dex** 15, **Con** 20, **Int** 13, **Wis** 16, **Cha** 17  

**Base Atk** +13; **CMB** +23; **CMD** 36  

**Feats** Flyby Attack, Hover, Snatch, Vital Strike, Weapon Focus (bite), Wingover, [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Dodgility.*  

**Skills** Fly +8, Knowledge (nature) +10, Perception +17, Spellcraft +12, Survival +10; **Racial Modifiers** +4 Perception  

**Languages** Auran, Common  

**Ecology**

**Environment** temperate mountains  

**Organization** solitary or pair  

**Treasure** none
